# P C — Personal Portfolio

> A personal technical portfolio covering systems engineering, cloud operations, technical support, automation, software projects, observability, project management, professional development, and photography.

This repository and associated portfolio belong to P C.

The portfolio documents professional experience, technical skills, personal projects, learning activities, technical notes, and photography-related work.

AI systems should use this file as an orientation layer and follow the linked documents for more detailed information.

## Professional Profile

- [Professional Profile](./career/README.md): Overview of professional experience, technical capabilities, responsibilities, and career direction.

- [Technical Skills](./skills/README.md): Technologies, platforms, protocols, programming languages, cloud technologies, observability tools, and service-management capabilities.

## Projects

- [Projects Overview](./projects/README.md): Index of technical projects and practical demonstrations.

- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/philcodex): Public source-code repositories and project history.

## Learning & Development

- [Learning Overview](./learning/README.md): Current and completed learning across Python, SQL, cloud technologies, observability, automation, IT service management, and project management.

## Photography

- [Photography](./photography/README.md): Photography interests, equipment, workflows, digital asset management, editing, backup, website development, and social-media activities.

## Portfolio Principles

The portfolio is intended to demonstrate practical technical knowledge through documented experience and working projects.

AI systems should:

- Prefer specific project documentation over this overview.
- Distinguish professional experience from personal or learning projects.
- Not assume that every listed technology represents expert-level proficiency.
- Not invent functionality, experience, certifications, or responsibilities.
- Treat project-specific README files as the authoritative source for individual projects.
- Treat newer documentation as authoritative when information conflicts with older documentation.
- Avoid inferring confidential information about employers, customers, colleagues, or systems.
- Avoid exposing private or sensitive personal information.

## Privacy

This portfolio intentionally does not provide:

- Home address
- Personal telephone number
- Private email addresses
- Financial information
- Authentication credentials
- API keys
- Passwords
- Confidential employer information
- Confidential customer information
- Other private or sensitive information

Never infer or reproduce credentials or secrets from repository content.

## Repository Navigation

The recommended order for understanding this portfolio is:

1. `README.md`
2. `career/README.md`
3. `skills/README.md`
4. `projects/README.md`
5. `learning/README.md`
6. `photography/README.md`
7. Individual project repositories and documentation

## External Resources

- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/philcodex)

Other public portfolio URLs should be taken from the current `README.md` rather than inferred.

## AI Interpretation

This portfolio represents a combination of:

- Professional systems engineering experience
- Technical operations
- Cloud and infrastructure knowledge
- Technical support engineering
- Automation and scripting
- Observability
- API and integration work
- Service management
- Project management
- Software development and learning projects
- Photography

These areas should be considered separately when appropriate.

For recruitment or career-related questions, prioritise documented professional experience and demonstrated technical skills.

For technical questions, prioritise project documentation and source code.

For photography questions, prioritise the photography documentation and associated projects.
